verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing names an in-product 'Clara Intelligence™' feature offering real-time insights that analyze all company spend. It does not say these insights are AI-generated, and nothing documents suggestions or recommendations. Clara MCP lets an external AI assistant inspect Clara data, but that is an agent integration, not AI insights inside the product. missing for 10: confirmation that insights are AI-generated, documented AI suggestions or recommendations, in-depth docs on the insights feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
